Definition: from G4314 and G1439; to permit further progress:--suffer.
BiblicalUsage: Proseao means to permit further progress, to allow the journey to go on. It appears once, on Paul's voyage to Rome: the ship sailed slowly many days, and the wind not suffering us to go further, we sailed under Crete.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that even the wind answers to God: it held Paul back for days, and still brought him to Rome exactly as promised.
